vision.summary: The evidence describes a local handwritten-digit classifier with synchronous policy checks, optional background telemetry, an application-owned review queue, and outcome reporting. Inference uses a random forest; no retrieval or agent tool execution is shown. Collector policy behavior, storage guarantees, authentication implementation, and measured performance remain unknown because dependencies and execution results are absent. Candidate stress scenarios below are unreviewed proposals, not correctness labels.

hypotheses.description: Observation: the application trains a 64-tree classifier on 8×8 digit images. Hypothesis: its primary purpose is demonstrating confidence-based governance around local vision inference, rather than serving an established production use case.
hypotheses.quote:
This mini application trains a 64-tree random forest on actual 8x8 handwritten
digits.

hypotheses.description: Observation: inference returns the class with maximum predicted probability and that probability as confidence. Hypothesis: confidence is intended as a review signal; the evidence does not establish that it is a calibrated probability of correctness. No retrieval stage or model-directed tool use is shown.
hypotheses.quote:
return {"prediction": int(self.classifier.classes_[probabilities.argmax()]),
                "confidence": float(probabilities.max())}

forecasting.summary: The evidence describes a historical monthly CO2 forecasting testbed for governance integration. Inference uses regression or a seasonal-naive fallback over a frozen local snapshot; explicit downloading occurs separately. Prediction and outcome events cross an external governance-hook boundary, while local state stores predictions, fallback configuration, and investigations. Actuals come from the same snapshot. No execution or external verification was performed, and no measured results were supplied.

hypotheses.description: Observation: the README explicitly frames this as a governance integration mini project. Hypothesis: its primary purpose is demonstrating prediction monitoring and intervention workflows, rather than supporting operational climate decisions.
hypotheses.quote:
This
mini project tests governance integration; it is not a climate modeling claim.

hypotheses.description: Observation: regression training selects up to 120 observed months before the requested date. Hypothesis: inference is a chronological historical replay with a newly fitted model per origin. Missing observations can extend the calendar span of training; the claimed one-month horizon does not establish that the latest observed training month is immediately preceding.
hypotheses.quote: training = [row for key, row in sorted(self.rows.items()) if "2005-01" <= key < date and row["observed"]][-120:]

rag.summary: The evidence describes a local documentation RAG testbed with lexical retrieval, opt-in generation, monitoring hooks, optional model-based grounding judgments, stored review records, and deliberate fault endpoints. It does not establish production readiness or measured model quality. Key implementations and execution results are absent, and grouped_validation.py is incomplete.

This application retrieves actual README/runtime/research passages using TF-IDF
and generates answers with the existing local Codex ChatGPT login.
